description: Terraria-style crafting for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric): a browser of everything you can currently craft, chained crafting, and target-driven crafters.

mods.name: Terraria Crafting
mods.description: Replaces grid crafting with a Terraria-style browser of everything you can currently craft.

releases.notes:
Fixes accidental crafting, adds recipe cost tooltips, and removes the crafting recipe book.

Fixed
- Crafting no longer triggers on stray gestures. Previously any slot click counted: throwing with Q over a result, double-clicking one, dragging across the grid, a number-key swap, or the synthetic clicks some inventory-tweak mods send when you scroll. Only a normal click and a shift-click craft now.
- The browser always consumes scroll, so scrolling the recipe list can no longer be turned into slot clicks by other mods.

Added
- Hovering a recipe shows what one craft costs, grouped per ingredient.

Changed
- The crafting recipe book is disabled. With no 2x2 grid it had nothing to fill, and it rebuilt its recipe index on every recipe sync. Furnace, blast furnace and smoker recipe books are untouched.
- Crafting no longer unlocks recipes, which removes a packet per craft and the "New Recipes Unlocked" toasts.

releases.notes:
First beta of Terraria Crafting.

Crafting browser
- Press B (or right-click a crafting table) to open a browser of everything you can craft right now.
- Click a result to take it on your cursor; shift+left-click crafts one into your inventory; shift+right-click crafts as many as your materials allow.
- Chained crafting: holding only logs still shows a crafting table as craftable, and clicking it runs log -> planks -> table for you.
- Only craftable recipes are shown by default; the toggle reveals the rest, greyed out.
- The grid stays put while you craft: items you can no longer afford grey out in place instead of re-sorting under your cursor.
- Search by name, or drop an item into the filter slot to see only recipes that use it.

Stations and storage
- Crafting tables act as stations: without one nearby you are limited to 2x2 recipes.
- Chests, barrels and other containers are included in what you can craft from, as long as they are connected to the table - touching it, or touching a container that does.

Crafters
- Give a crafter a target item and each of its slots becomes a stackable hopper for one ingredient.
- Each craft spends the right amount from each slot, and wrong items are refused by hand and by hopper alike.

Vanilla grid crafting is removed; the inventory's 2x2 grid is replaced with a button that opens the browser.
